claim: Trains continuous normalizing flows by regressing vector fields along conditional probability paths without simulated training trajectories.
claim_zh: 利用条件概率路径的速度场回归训练连续归一化流，减少训练阶段对轨迹仿真的依赖。
innovation_detail: Trains continuous normalizing flows by regressing vector fields along conditional probability paths without simulated training trajectories.
innovation_detail_zh: 利用条件概率路径的速度场回归训练连续归一化流，减少训练阶段对轨迹仿真的依赖。
bottleneck: Maximum-likelihood training of continuous normalizing flows can require costly ODE solve differentiation.
bottleneck_zh: 传统连续归一化流的似然训练往往需要昂贵的ODE轨迹求解与求导。
tradeoff: Sampling still requires solving the learned transport ODE and probability coverage must be checked.
